newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Mexico's Ortiz sees no early drop in interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ortiz sees no early drop in interest rate.

text.p: Mexican short-term interest rates are unlikely to fall soon but rates could ease if the market is convinced that inflation is on the decline, Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said on Friday.
"I don't see a big decline in short-term rates in the next few weeks," he told Reuters Financial Television.
"If the market convinces itself that inflation will be under two percent after February, there is some room for rates to come down, particularly at the long end," Ortiz added.
He said the jump in December inflation was a one-off event and predicted the monthly rate would fall below two percent in February.
